links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate and polyp detection rate with versus without AI-assisted colonoscopy
links.effect: ADR 35% pre-AI vs 31% with AI (p=0.2); PDR 42% vs 38% (p=0.22); adenomas per colonoscopy 0.62 vs 0.51 (p=0.22); withdrawal time shorter with AI (9.34 vs 10.44 min, p<0.0001).
links.quote: ADR was 151 (35%) in the pre-AIAC group and 116 (31%) in AIAC group, with no statistical significance (p = 0.2).

links.outcome: Endoscopist detection performance with AI in intended workflow versus without AI
links.effect: No significant improvement in ADR (35% vs 31%, p=0.2) or PDR (42% vs 38%, p=0.22) for experienced endoscopist; withdrawal time significantly shorter with AI (9.34 vs 10.44 min; p<0.0001).
links.quote: AIAC may not significantly improve adenoma or PDRs when performed by an experienced endoscopist.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative study of real-world clinical deployment of an AI-assisted colonoscopy tool assessing clinical outcomes (ADR, PDR) and procedure metrics.
